name: Superset
where_agents_run: your machine; other machines you add through its relay; its cloud workspaces where your account has them; iPhone app reaches them
license: Elastic-2.0 (source-available); desktop app free, Pro $20 per user per month ($15 billed yearly)
source_note: Checked against docs.superset.sh (full docs text), superset.sh llms.txt, pricing and mobile blog posts, the repo README and desktop package.json, and the latest release (desktop v1.33.0). Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode and more side by side

harness_count.value: 20 named CLIs plus its own chat; others via custom command

needs_you_signal.value: Hook-driven waiting and done alerts, sounds, dock badge

approve_deny_prompt.value: Its own chat agent only; others ask in their terminal

cross_provider_delegation.value: Coordinator hands parts to any agent, one workspace each

always_on_assistant.value: @superset Slack bot files tasks and starts agents (Pro)

conversation_gui_view.value: Chat for its own agent only; others are terminals

real_terminal.value: Agent's own terminal per workspace, survives restarts

session_organization.value: Workspaces per project, with sessions, tabs and splits

prompt_scratchpad.value: Rich prompt editor; auto-run off stages prompts unsent

saved_prompt_library.value: Searchable prompt history and saved terminal scripts

builtin_editors_browser.value: Code editor, diff viewer, in-app browser

appearance_control.value: Themes, theme files and marketplace, terminal font size

usage_hud.value: 5-hour and weekly limits per login, plus token costs

burn_rate_forecast.value: Usage and resets only; no forecast in docs

account_hotswap.value: Several Claude or Codex logins, switched per launch

vault_task_source.value: Not in its docs; tasks come from Linear or GitHub

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: GitHub or Linear issue to PR, merged in the app

worktree_management.value: Every workspace is its own git worktree and branch

planner_orchestrator.value: Orchestrate skill lets one agent split work across workers

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Agents read and write other terminals through its CLI

native_mobile_app.value: iPhone app (iOS 26, Pro plan); Android waitlist

phone_no_new_app.value: FAQ: no supported web dashboard; phone needs its app

remote_ssh.value: Other machines through its relay (paid), not SSH

voice_input.value: Dictation in the iPhone app only

os.value: macOS; Linux AppImage experimental; Windows planned; iPhone app

languages.value: TypeScript (GitHub's main language; percentage split not reachable here)

background_process.value: Yes: host-service daemon and a terminal daemon

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Medium (estimate: Electron app plus host and terminal daemons)

runs_in_terminal.value: Desktop app; its CLI can drive agents from any terminal

extensibility.value: CLI, TypeScript SDK, MCP server, theme marketplace

teams_multiuser.value: Organizations, shared machines; SSO on Enterprise

stability_maturity.value: v1.33.0 (2026-09-30), daily releases since late 2025; Linux experimental
